study: spec 014: time-late, the classical follow-on to Gate T

decided.D1: share of the log gain C″ → search2 that c2-refit obtains, Annex B test split, with its 95% interval (FR-005)
decided.D2: shares of wrong-history periods classed ambiguous, search failure, evidence failure at threshold 3 and a 120 s match (FR-006)
decided.D3: attainable headroom: geometric mean per-period ratio search2 ÷ ident-search and search2 ÷ ident-all, each material / not material / inconclusive against 1.10 (FR-007)
decided.D4: false-manoeuvre rate on held-course periods for search2, C″, search-flat and search-mix, each interval within ±0.05 (FR-010)
decided.D5: recommendation on a learned whole-period model by the rule below (SC-006)

forecasts.D1: 0.75; the interval will include 0.6 and will not include 0.3
forecasts.D2: ambiguous 0.45, evidence failure 0.45, search failure 0.10; search failure below 0.20
forecasts.D4: search2 0.80; C″ 0.03; search-flat 0.02; search-mix 0.10 (six tuning periods seen: 0 of 6), and search-mix within 1.10 of search2 on Annex B data
forecasts.soundness: pass: reference at 1.0 to 1.2 of the bound on tight rows; every true-history fit consistent
forecasts.reported: search-flat ÷ search2 about 1.0 on Annex B data and above 1.0 under the shift; c2-refit no better than C″ under the shift; ekf-rts worse than C″; correlated and outlying errors hurt every system and the search's manoeuvre counts most

recommendation_rule: Pursue a learned whole-period model only if the ident-all headroom is material on the Annex B test split. If so it is registered against search2, search-mix and c2-refit under the same prior, on the Annex B, shifted and held-course splits. Not material or inconclusive: no GPU budget is spent on it. Fixed in research R9 before the tuning run.
soundness_stop: validation seed 334: history-fixed range efficiency on rows bounded below 0.05 within [0.8, 1.3] and at least 0.90 of true-history fits with a consistent cost; otherwise seed 335 is not generated
added_after_tuning: search-mix (Annex B prior mixed half and half with a target that never manoeuvres; the half is stated, not tuned), because the tuning seed showed search2 declaring a manoeuvre on 81% of held-course periods. Reported under D4; it changes no other decided quantity.
